item.title: Bomb threats on several flights force unplanned landings
item.body: Bomb threats have been reported on multiple flights, including two that took off from the UK. Planes were forced to make unplanned landings, and airports temporarily closed.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ✈️ Bomb threats on several flights force unplanned landings

Bomb threats have been reported on multiple flights, including two that took off from the UK. Planes were forced to make unplanned landings, and airports temporarily closed.

Source: Sky News | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 3 November, 13:50

#BreakingNews #AirportSecurity #UKNews
